topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Sensing via PAMPs and DAMPs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular cues of infection and cellular damage that the innate immune system uses to distinguish foreign threats from self.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptors and Downstream Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genomic encoding, subcellular locations, receptor families, and activation pathways that transduce danger signals into cellular responses.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade and Leukocyte Recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cell activation drives local leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic priming of adaptive immunity, and systemic inflammatory pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Tissue Repair
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how the immune system halts inflammation, repairs damaged tissue, and manages persistent threats through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on complement.
